text: In this 5-minute video, explore the arguments for and against the Gospel accounts.
Can we trust the story of Jesus?
We have more accurate historical accounts for the story of Jesus than for Alexander the Great or Julius Caesar.

name: nua2
text: Jesus’ tomb was found empty three days after his death-what could have happened to the body?
Someone stole it from the tomb
He actually rose from the dead
...one of the soldiers pierced Jesus' side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
One of many ways to God

name: nua8
text: Why did Jesus have to die, and does it affect my life at all?
Do you need to change to be good enough for God?
No, He will accept me as I am
"God sent his Son into the world not to judge the world, but to save the world through him."
What does Jesus have to do with me
He came to free me from sin

name: nua9
text: Jesus Christ loves you and wants to have a relationship with you. But how does it begin?
Would you like to follow Jesus Christ?
Jesus, thank you for loving me, thank you for the worth you speak into my life by dying for my sin.
I confess, that I need your forgiveness. I want to turn from living for myself and trust you to take the lead in my life,
I want to join life's adventure with you and become the person you made me to be.
